definition.name: Ion Bolt
definition.description: Disables a target unit, preventing movement and attacks for 3 turns.

definition.name: Designate Target
definition.description: Marks an enemy unit. Friendly units deal +50% damage against it for 4 turns.

definition.name: Adaptive Forcefield
definition.description: Reduces incoming damage by 75% for 3 turns.

definition.name: Missile Batteries
definition.description: Deploys 3 missile platforms that automatically attack enemies for 4 turns.
